overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures premium dehydrated tomato flakes from carefully selected ripe tomatoes. As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we clean, sort, cut, and dehydrate fresh tomatoes under controlled conditions. This process locks in natural aroma, color, and savory flavor while lowering moisture content to five percent or less, offering seamless year-round formulation stability for industrial food processors.

Our dehydrated tomato flakes feature an eight to sixteen mesh cut profile, ensuring uniform rehydration and consistent dispersion in diverse recipe systems. We support international importers with complete export documentation, flexible order quantities starting at five kilograms, and full OEM private labeling. Every batch follows our six-step production process, delivering dependable purity, enhanced shelf stability, and low handling losses.
highlights: Processed from ripe tomatoes with controlled dehydration
Low moisture content of 5 percent or less
Extended 12-month shelf life in recommended storage
Natural red color and rich savory tomato flavor
HS Code 07129090 with complete batch traceability

Pizza, pasta, and noodle seasoning blends

Foodservice, cloud kitchen, and QSR recipes
Food products requiring visible tomato inclusions
packaging: 25 kg bags with food-grade protective liners
5 kg to 10 kg food-grade bulk bags
Small private-label pouches and jars for retail

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated tomato flakes?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity starts at 5 kg for standard orders, accommodating both trial sampling and large-scale bulk supply requirements.

faqs.q: What mesh size and moisture specifications are offered?
faqs.a: The standard cut profile is 8 to 16 mesh with a moisture content of 5 percent or less. Custom mesh profiles are available on request.

faqs.q: Can TradeNest Naturals provide private label packaging?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide full OEM and private label services, packaging product into custom retail pouches, jars, or bulk bags to buyer specifications.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life and proper storage recommendation?
faqs.a: The product has a shelf life of 12 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, excessive heat, and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you offer product samples for industrial testing?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide product samples and technical specification sheets on request to assist your formulation and testing needs.

faqs.q: What export documentation support is provided?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we provide comprehensive export documentation support including commercial invoices, packing lists, and specification sheets for customs clearance.
